sourceSufficiencyAssessment: The selected central argument has sufficient primary support without certifying the complete edition. Actual sample passages establish the definition and its disagreement, the intertwined-cause thesis, key cases and limits of the neural evidence. The author interview supplies the narrower change/ethics propositions; the openly labelled précis supports only the stated general points. No invented cases, silent other-book/film import, fatalism or settled-universal-proof claim found. The retained practices are philosophical implications rather than a medical or legal implementation protocol. One experimental comparator is misstated in RU and should be corrected; that local wording defect does not create a need for unseen chapters or a broad rewrite.
substantiveParityAssessment: Read all 21 RU/EN pairs plus metadata/method/source notes and three connected routes in both languages. Thesis, chance versus authorship, causal change, safety versus retribution and equal consideration preserve substantive meaning. Film is an author hypothetical, not an imported plot; the shirt anecdote is explicitly from the interview, not an alleged book ending. At libet the RU temporal comparison is wrong; EN leaves the intended comparison implicit. Make both explicit as below.

findings.type: reported intention time confused with time of reporting
findings.exactRu: В опытах Либета участник делает простое движение и сообщает, когда почувствовал намерение. Регистрируемый мозговой сигнал готовности появляется раньше этого сообщения.
findings.exactEn: In Libet’s experiments, a participant makes a simple movement and reports when an intention was felt. A recorded readiness signal appears earlier.
findings.reason: The critical comparison is readiness-potential onset versus the moment at which the participant says the intention first arose, not versus the later act of communicating the report. RU explicitly says before this report; that changes the experimental observation into a trivial chronological fact. EN may be read correctly but leaves the comparator implicit. The following sentence about subjective onset helps, yet does not repair the explicit RU comparator. This is a finding about the described experiment, not a current-science efficacy claim or an objection to the author’s thesis.
findings.minimalCorrectionRu: Заменить второе предложение: «Регистрируемый мозговой сигнал готовности появляется раньше названного участником момента возникновения намерения». Сохранить последующую оговорку: один этот результат не решает спор.
findings.minimalCorrectionEn: Make the second sentence explicit for parity: “The recorded readiness signal begins before the time the participant reports first feeling the intention.” Retain the following qualification that this result alone does not settle the dispute.
findings.primaryLocator: printed pp. 22–23 (PDF pp. 35–36), original Libet setup and timing; limits on pp. 28–32 and 39

limits: REQUIRES-FIXES is limited to DET-SR-01, a short experimental-timing correction. Author-meaning/source sufficiency otherwise passes within the selected retained argument.
